# Discord Tools (Jackybot.xyz)

> Free, privacy-focused online video utilities optimized for Discord users. No sign-up required. The best free video compressor and trimmer for Discord.

## Overview

Discord Tools provides free online video compression and trimming tools specifically designed for Discord users. Our tools help users compress videos to Discord's 8MB file size limit and trim video clips easily, all without requiring Discord Nitro or any registration.

## Primary Tools

### 1. Compress Video for Discord (8MB Video Compressor)

- **Primary Use Case**: Compress video for Discord to meet the 8MB file size limit without Nitro

  - Compress any video to under 8MB instantly
  - Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WebM, M4V, WMV, FLV, MPEG, MPG input formats

## How to Compress Video for Discord

**Step-by-step process:**
1. Visit https://www.jackybot.xyz/8mb
2. Upload your video file (drag & drop or click to browse)
3. Select output format (AV1 recommended for best quality with sound)
4. Click "Convert Video"
5. Download your compressed video (under 8MB, ready for Discord)
